ns2:section.sectionText: Promoting Undergraduate Research in Engineering (PURE) is a research program that aims to provide first-hand research experience to underclassmen in engineering. The PURE program pairs graduate mentors with undergraduate students on a semester-long research project that is conducted in a professor's research lab. Students are expected to produce and present posters at the year-end symposium. Student must be apply and be accepted to PURE before enrolling in the ENG 199 PUR course. For further details, please visit https:https://pure.engr.illinois.edu.
